atoms.text: Chongo enjoyed working with his best friend, Falurna. She loved the Furcumbers just as much as he did. Furcumber Farm was growing more furcumbers than ever!
atoms.sound: ssml: Chongo enjoyed working with his best friend, Falurna. She loved the Furcumbers just as much as he did.<break time='500ms'/> Furcumber Farm was growing more furcumbers than ever!

atoms.text: One day, Falurna sat down to talk with Chongo. She asked, “Chongo, how would you like to start growing furmelons? I think furmelons would make a lot of people happy.” Falurna was excited about this idea.
atoms.sound: ssml: One day, Falurna sat down to talk with Chongo. She asked, <voice voice='f2'>  “Chongo, how would you like to start growing furmelons? I think furmelons would make a lot of people happy.”</voice> Falurna was excited about this idea.

atoms.text: Chongo was shocked. “But Falurna, we are called ‘Furcumber Farm’ and we have only grown furcumbers since my great uncle Chongo the Green built this farm!”
atoms.sound: ssml: Chongo was shocked. <voice voice='m1'>“But Falurna, we are called ‘Furcumber Farm’ and we have only grown furcumbers since my great uncle Chongo the Green built this farm!” </voice>

atoms.text: This did not surprise Falurna. She said, “Chongo, try this furmelon. I grew it in the garden behind the house. The soil here is perfect for them!”
atoms.sound: ssml: This did not surprise Falurna. She said, <voice voice='f2'>“Chongo, try this furmelon. I grew it in the garden behind the house. The soil here is perfect for them!” </voice>

atoms.text: Chongo took a bite of the furmelon. It was delicious! He knew then that Falurna was right. It was time to grow the farm!
atoms.sound: ssml: Chongo took a bite of the furmelon. It was delicious! He knew then that Falurna was right. It was time to grow the farm!
